summary_1line: Paravasu accidentally kills his father, frames his brother; Arvavasu’s penance wins divine favor, restoring the dead and revealing the value of earned knowledge.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the dark forest, Paravasu looses an arrow at what he thinks is a deer, only to discover his father Raivya fallen in the black antelope skin.
Arvavasu stands emaciated in the wilderness performing severe penance as the radiant Sun-god appears before him in blazing form.
The assembled gods grant Arvavasu’s boons as the slain sages and Yavakri rise again to life before the sacred fire.
